title: ST-GNN-AAAS: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection in the Traveling Salesman Problem
abstract: arXiv:2611.32602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection (AAAS) aims to make solver choices under varying time budgets. The existing AAAS approaches largely rely on static instance characteristics and make limited use of temporal information revealed during solver execution. We propose ST-GNN-AAAS, a Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network framework for AAAS in the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The framework represents evolving incumbent tours using time-varying node features, including distances from each node to its neighbors in the current tour, and combines these features with solver performance observations over a short history window. Given this short history, ST-GNN-AAAS predicts solver selections over a longer future horizon. We evaluate the method on a subset of diverse TSP benchmarks from NATIONAL, TNM, TSPLIB, and VLSI, releasing the corresponding solver execution data to support reproducibility. Our model achieves a selection accuracy of 76.59

translated_title: ST-GNN-AAAS：面向旅行商问题中随时自动算法选择的时空图神经网络
translated_abstract: 随时自动算法选择旨在根据不同的时间预算来做出求解器选择。现有的AAAS方法主要依赖静态的实例特征，对求解器执行过程中所揭示的时间信息利用有限。我们提出了ST-GNN-AAAS，一个用于旅行商问题（TSP）中AAAS的时空图神经网络框架。该框架使用随时间变化的节点特征来表示不断演化的当前最优路径，包括每个节点到当前路径中其相邻节点的距离，并将这些特征与短时间历史窗口内的求解器性能观测相结合。基于这段短历史信息，ST-GNN-AAAS可以预测更长未来时段内的求解器选择。我们在来自NATIONAL、TNM、TSPLIB和VLSI的多样化TSP基准测试子集上评估了该方法，并发布了相应的求解器执行数据以支持可复现性。我们的模型达到了76.59的选择准确率。
tldr: 提出了一种时空图神经网络框架ST-GNN-AAAS，通过融合当前最优路径的时变节点特征与求解器短期性能历史来预测未来的求解器选择，实现了旅行商问题中随不同时间预算变化的自动算法选择。
en_tdlr: A spatio-temporal graph neural network framework, ST-GNN-AAAS, that leverages time-varying node features of evolving incumbent tours combined with short solver performance histories to predict solver selections, enabling anytime automatic algorithm selection for the TSP under varying time budgets.
